policy: Term 1 begins on the published term start, 27 January, although government-school students start on 28 January.
PUBLIC_HOLIDAY contains only the thirteen listed dates that are not subject to the Melbourne Cup local-substitution exception.
Melbourne Cup on 3 November is not asserted as a uniform statewide holiday; it and every published local-holiday date are marked REGIONAL_HOLIDAY_UNCERTAIN.

No local-boundary dataset is required. The uncertainty marker applies conservatively throughout Victoria on that date, including locations where the local answer could be established with additional data.

Only an otherwise relevant school-day or additional-Public-Holiday rule needs regional_holiday_uncertain. Static rules, off-window rules, non-term school dates and already-matching ordinary weekday schedules remain resolvable.
The half-day local holiday is conservatively uncertain for the whole date because this minimal reference does not encode its local extent or hours.
Dates are ISO values checked against primary pages. Do not replace them with automatically parsed DataVic API timestamps, which showed day/month conversion discrepancies during the earlier audit.
Calendar-dependent lookup is supported only for 2026. Absence of rows in another year does not establish that it is a non-holiday year.
The regional source publishes declarations throughout the year. This is a dated reference snapshot; refresh and revalidate it when declarations or annual dates change.
The geographic scope of speed lookup is statewide. Regional uncertainty dates are not a restriction to the former three LGAs.
